title: Get a permit to run a function or event on council property
what: Get the council's permit before running a function or entertainment event on council property or another public place.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. The council adopted the Exmouth local law with modifications (Gazette No. 98, 16 Jun 2003); the clause is quoted from that law as made. The adopting law modifies this clause, so the quoted words may differ.

assessment.summary: Events on council property need the council's permit.
